official_companion.purpose: The official v1 PCQM4Mv2 SMILES/split companion used only for remote identity association. Every member is hash-locked before a CSV row is read or a legacy unsafe torch load is allowed.

integrity_order: verify bytes, canonical samefile identity, and SHA-256 of every source artifact before opening the SDF, CSV, or split_dict.pt
verify the companion ZIP and its two selected member CRC/size/content hashes against the separately locked extracted files
verify hashes and fixed semantic facts of the three supporting manifests
only then allow a safe torch.load attempt; a legacy fallback remains explicitly acknowledged and bound to the verified split hash
